confined to {0} u [11,250] u {255} on a 5-bit channel (R,B) and

are the top of the dither window of the extreme non-saturating code and both
are measured at both widths. The change is confined to dither_to_residue in

plasma and bands images. It also independently pins the 6-bit high bound of
